_comment: This is a TEMPLATE, not real data. Copy this file to reference_service_time.json, commit it once filled in (it's just player IDs/dates/figures, nothing sensitive), and replace every row with a real figure you looked up yourself on a player's Baseball Reference page.
_how_to_fill_this_in: 1. Pick a player whose service time is well-established and unlikely to be a grievance/manipulation edge case.
2. Go to their Baseball Reference page and find the service time snapshot for the season you want to check, e.g. the 's.2021' figure shown for that Opening Day.

3. Add a row below with their MLB Stats API player_id (visible in this project's URLs or via https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/people/search?names=Full+Name), the as_of date (that season's Opening Day), and the expected figure exactly as B-R shows it (e.g. "5.014").
